name: What should I do after being charged with a DUI?

mainEntity.name: What should I do after being charged with a DUI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately contact a criminal defense attorney for guidance. Do not speak to police without representation, and keep records of the incident and any communications for your defense.angeloreyeslaw​
